description: Export artboards as lean SVG for the web (File > Export > Export As > SVG): styling, object IDs, decimals, minify, responsive

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

images.description: embed, link, or preserve (keep each image as it is placed). Default preserve

minify.description: Strip whitespace and shorten the markup. Default false

outlineText.description: Convert text to outlines instead of SVG text. Default false

outputFile.description: Absolute .svg path. With several artboards Illustrator adds the artboard name to each file

responsive.description: Omit width and height so the SVG scales to its container. Default true

styling.description: internal_css (a style element, default), inline_style, or presentation_attributes

name: export_web_svg
title: Export Web SVG
